title: FHIR R4 Patient — platform ingestion schema
description: Starter JSON Schema for the platform's Patient ingestion payload. This is not the official HL7 FHIR R4 Patient schema or a profile validator. Additional FHIR elements are permitted.

id.description: Required by the platform ingestion endpoint; used as the unique persisted resource identifier.

meta.description: FHIR resource metadata; contents are not checked by the current runtime validator.

name.description: FHIR HumanName array; omission is currently a warning, and the runtime validator does not inspect its structure.

gender.description: If non-null, must be one of the supported administrative gender codes.

birthDate.description: FHIR date; format is not checked by the current runtime validator.
